components.css: .ds-panel { padding: clamp(28px, 4vw, 52px); border-radius: 28px; color: var(--text); font-family: var(--font); border: 1px solid var(--glass-edge); box-shadow: var(--glass-shadow), inset 0 1px 0 var(--glass-top); background: linear-gradient(155deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--c) 18%, transparent), transparent 62%), var(--glass-bg); backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur)) saturate(165%); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur)) saturate(165%); } .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin: 0; padding: 6px 14px 6px 12px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--line); font-size: 0.94rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-dot { position: relative; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--c); } .ds-dot::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 50%; border: 1.5px solid var(--c); animation: ds-ping 2.6s var(--ease-out) infinite; } @keyframes ds-ping { from { scale: 1; opacity: 0.9; } to { scale: 2.8; opacity: 0; } } .ds-lines { margin: 30px 0 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; display: grid; gap: 12px; } .ds-lines li { position: relative; padding-left: 28px; font-size: 1.06rem; } .ds-lines li::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 4px; top: 0.62em; width: 7px; height: 7px; background: var(--c); rotate: 45deg; }

components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; max-width: 340px; font-family: var(--font); } .ds-tab { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 34px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 16px; width: 100%; padding: 18px 18px 18px 20px; border-radius: 22px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: var(--text); font: inherit; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 400ms var(--ease-out), border-color 400ms var(--ease-out), box-shadow 400ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-tab:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 4%, transparent); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--c-openmixing); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-tab[aria-selected='true'] { background: var(--glass-bg-strong); border-color: var(--glass-edge); box-shadow: 0 18px 40px -26px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.55), inset 0 1px 0 var(--glass-top); } .ds-glyph { width: 32px; height: 32px; filter: saturate(0.15); opacity: 0.55; transition: filter 500ms var(--ease-out), opacity 500ms var(--ease-out), rotate 900ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-tab[aria-selected='true'] .ds-glyph { filter: none; opacity: 1; rotate: 90deg; } .ds-tab > span { display: grid; gap: 2px; } .ds-tab-name { font-size: 1.3rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.015em; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-tab-kind { font-size: 0.94rem; color: var(--text-2); line-height: 1.35; } .ds-key { min-width: 26px; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 7px; border: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--text-3); text-align: center; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 0.78rem; }

narrative.overview:
Glass is a lens, not a finish. The whole system is a quiet ground carrying exactly three geometric primitives, one per project, with frosted panes set over them. Colour lives in the primitives; the glass shows it. A primitive read crisp outside a pane and blurred inside it is the system's single visual idea, and every surface either holds a pane, shows a primitive, or stays out of the way. Codeboros is a ring with a gap that slowly turns, OpenMixing two overlapping discs, OpenHouse a triangle roof over a square.

Density is low and the voice is calm: one humanist geometric sans (Jost) at medium weight for every voice, generous section spacing, pill controls, one hairline weight. Motion is slow and eased: primitives drift on 19 to 90 second loops, panes rise in over 1.3 seconds, and focusing a project glides its primitive under the glass while the pane tints toward its colour. The system ships in two equal themes, ink-blue dark and cool porcelain light, with the same primitives a step deeper in light.

The retired pixel/game world is the confirmed anti-reference: no pixel art, no game vocabulary, no stepped or bitmap rendering.
keyCharacteristics: Three primitives, three hues, one per project; neutral UI everywhere else.
Frosted panes: translucent fill, 26px backdrop blur with 165% saturation, thin bright edge, inset top highlight, soft offset shadow, pointer-following specular.
Jost 500 for every heading and control; Geist Mono only for real commands and code.
Pills for controls (999px), 28px for panes, 1px hairlines only.
Dark and light themes are peers, switched by `data-theme`, defaulting to the OS.

rules.name: The Three Primitives Rule
rules.body: A project hue appears only attached to its project: its shape, its dot, its bullets, its badge, its pane tint. Neutral UI never borrows coral or mint; indigo's only exception is focus, selection and caret.

rules.name: The Lens Rule
rules.body: Panes are never filled with a solid project colour. A pane takes colour only by what sits behind it, plus at most an 18% project-colour gradient at 155deg fading out by 62%.

rules.name: The Ink Step Rule
rules.body: When a project hue is text, use its `-ink` step, never the base hue.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Jost speaks every role. Geist Mono appears only where the text is a real command, path or key (`code`, `kbd`).

rules.name: The Medium Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Headings and controls are weight 500. 600 is reserved for the wordmark and the two-letter tool buttons. Nothing is set in uppercase.

rules.name: The Frosted Slab Rule
rules.body: Anything that floats is glass: translucent fill, backdrop blur, 1px bright edge, inset top highlight, soft long shadow. There is no opaque floating card.

rules.name: The Specular Rule
rules.body: Panes carry a 460px radial highlight that follows the pointer (`--mx`, `--my`), fading out by 62%.

rules.name: The Roof Up Rule
rules.body: Wherever glyphs turn on hover or selection, the house never rotates.

dos: **Do** give every project exactly one primitive and one hue, and keep those pairings fixed (ring and coral, discs and indigo, house and mint).
**Do** let primitives cross pane edges so the lens reads: crisp outside, blurred inside.
**Do** build anything that floats as glass: glass fill, 1px glass edge, inset top highlight, pane shadow, 28px radius.
**Do** use pills (999px) for every control, chip and badge.
**Do** use the `-ink` step whenever a project hue is set as text.
**Do** ship both themes from the same tokens, switching with `data-theme`.
**Do** ease with cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) and keep motion slow; respect reduced motion.
donts: **Don't** reintroduce the retired pixel/game world: no pixel art, bitmap fonts, stepped shapes or game vocabulary.
**Don't** fill a pane or a neutral control with a solid project colour.
**Don't** set Geist Mono on anything that is not a real command, path or key.
**Don't** use weights above 500 for headings, or uppercase tracked labels.
**Don't** use hard offset shadows or opaque floating cards.
